create_AnnealingLR_scheduler: create an AnnealingLR scheduler with linear cosine or constant decay style for a PyTorch optimizer
get_lr_current_rate: get the current annealed learning rate from an AnnealingLR scheduler based on the current iteration
step_AnnealingLR_advance: step the AnnealingLR scheduler forward to update the optimizer learning rate for the next iteration
save_AnnealingLR_state: save the AnnealingLR scheduler state dict with start_lr warmup_iter decay_style and end_iter values
load_AnnealingLR_checkpoint: load an AnnealingLR scheduler state dict from a checkpoint to resume training with the correct learning rate
